name: What is the installation process for energy-efficient windows?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for energy-efficient windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our window installation process typically begins with a free in-home consultation to discuss your needs and provide a detailed estimate. Once you approve the project, we'll schedule a convenient installation date. On installation day, our team carefully removes your old windows and prepares the openings. New energy-efficient windows are then precisely fitted, leveled, and sealed to ensure maximum performance and weather resistance. We use high-quality flashing and insulation to prevent air and water leaks. Finally, we clean up the work area thoroughly and conduct a final walkthrough with you to ensure your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, old window removal, new window fitting and sealing, and a final walkthrough to ensure proper installation and satisfaction.
